description_en: Queries a list of backup sets of full backup or point-in-time backup for an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
description_zh: 查看AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版实例的数据备份列表和可恢复点
name: DescribeDataBackups

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the backup set. If you specify BackupId, the details of the backup set are returned.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/210093.html operation to query the information about all backup sets of an instance, including backup set IDs
parameters.help_zh:
备份集ID。如果带上BackupId，则是查询该备份详情。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/210093.html查看目标实例下的所有备份集信息，包括备份集ID
parameters.name: backup_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间。格式： yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，需要大于查询开始时间。格式： yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

30
50
100

Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数。取值说明：

30
50
100

默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The backup type. Valid values:

DATA: full backup.
RESTOREPOI: point-in-time recovery backup.

If you do not specify this parameter, the backup sets of full backup are returned
parameters.help_zh:
备份类型。取值说明：

DATA：全量备份。
RESTOREPOI：可恢复点。

如果不传，则默认返回全量备份集的记录
parameters.name: data_type

parameters.help_en:
The backup mode. Valid values:

Automated
Manual

If you do not specify this parameter, all backup sets are returned
parameters.help_zh:
备份模式。取值说明：

Automated：系统自动备份。
Manual：手动备份。

如果不传，则返回所有
parameters.name: backup_mode

parameters.help_en:
The state of the backup set. Valid values:

Success
Failed

If you do not specify this parameter, all backup sets are returned
parameters.help_zh:
备份集状态。取值说明：

Success：已完成备份。
Failed：备份失败。

如果不传，则返回所有
parameters.name: backup_status

BackupEndTime.description_en: The UTC time when the backup ended. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
BackupEndTime.description_zh: 备份结束时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

BackupEndTimeLocal.description_en: The local time when the backup ended. The time is in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format. The time is your local time
BackupEndTimeLocal.description_zh: 本次备份结束时间（当地时间）

BackupMethod.description_en:
The method that is used to generate the backup set. Valid values:

Logical: logical backup
Physical: physical backup
Snapshot: snapshot backup
BackupMethod.description_zh:
备份方式，返回值如下：
Physical：物理备份
Snapshot：快照备份

BackupMode.description_en:
The backup mode.

Valid values for full backup:

Automated: automatic backup
Manual: manual backup

Valid values for point-in-time backup:

Automated: point-in-time backup after full backup
Manual: manual point-in-time backup
Period: point-in-time backup that is triggered by a backup policy
BackupMode.description_zh:
备份模式。

全量备份取值说明：

Automated：系统自动备份。
Manual：手动备份。

恢复点取值说明：

Automated：全量备份后的恢复点。
Manual：用户手动触发的恢复点。
Period：因为备份策略，定时触发的恢复点

BackupSetId.description_en: The ID of the backup set

BackupSize.description_en: The size of the backup file. Unit: bytes

BackupStartTime.description_en: The UTC time when the backup started. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
BackupStartTime.description_zh: 备份开始时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

BackupStartTimeLocal.description_en: The local time when the backup started. The time is in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format. The time is your local time
BackupStartTimeLocal.description_zh: 本次备份开始时间（当地时间）

BackupStatus.description_en:
The status of the backup set. Valid values:

Success
Failure
BackupStatus.description_zh:
备份集状态。取值说明：

Success：成功。
Failure：失败

BaksetName.description_en: The name of a point-in-time backup set or the full backup set
BaksetName.description_zh: 恢复点名称或全量备份集名称

ConsistentTime.description_en:
For full backup, this parameter indicates the point in time at which the data in the data backup file is consistent.
For point-in-time backup, this parameter indicates that the returned point in time is a timestamp
ConsistentTime.description_zh:
全量备份：返回一致性时间点的时间戳。
可恢复点：返回可恢复时间点的时间戳

DataType.description_en:
The type of the backup. Valid values:

DATA: full backup
RESTOREPOI: point-in-time backup
DataType.description_zh:
备份类型。取值说明：

DATA：全量备份。
RESTOREPOI：可恢复点

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalBackupSize.description_en: The total backup set size. Unit: Byte

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
